answer: A bond is staked in a shared harbor tied to a lineage cluster key, and registration runs through a jetty whose berths are consumed one per parent signature, each extra clone from that parent paying an escalating congestion price. Juries seed planted honeypots on the island of open tasks: honest solves earn graded credit, honeypot submissions expose the clone, and because berths share the key, one catch burns the whole kindred bond and its berths, making N identities super-linear.
